dominant_breach: housing-entry score closure through tenant reports, eviction filings, credit files, and algorithmic screens
fastest_washout: unit loss before applicant can inspect, dispute, or explain the record

score_mediated_exclusion_gate.note: Tenant screening can defeat affordability and legal eligibility before move-in; this is now an active Gate 17 blocker.

tenant_screening_record_accuracy.note: Accuracy must be scored before denial: filings, stale records, criminal/credit data, and automated match logic can be overbroad or irrelevant.

eviction_record_shadow_penalty.note: Filing records can operate as a shadow penalty even when no final tenant liability is proven.

algorithmic_tenant_denial_explainability.note: HUD guidance makes algorithmic and third-party tenant screening a fair-housing issue requiring transparency and nondiscrimination.

record_suppression_clean_slate_rails.note: Clean-slate or sealing rules must be connected to tenant-screen vendor deletion and landlord decision timing.

adverse_action_reason_specificity.note: Applicant-facing denial reasons must be specific enough to contest before the unit is gone.

proof_debt: pre-denial applicant access and unit-preservation during dispute
eviction-filing use after dismissal, sealing, settlement, or nonpayment cure
adverse-action reason specificity across tenant-screen report families

gate_17_score_mediated_exclusion.why: Gate 17 is blocked: affordability cannot certify unless tenant-screen records are accurate, relevant, transparent, disputable before unit loss, and audited for disparate impact.

evidence_debt_register.question: pre-denial applicant access and unit-preservation during dispute
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect landlord and vendor policies showing whether applicants can inspect and contest records before denial becomes irreversible.

evidence_debt_register.question: eviction-filing use after dismissal, sealing, settlement, or nonpayment cure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure record suppression and vendor deletion after legal relief or nonfinal filings.

evidence_debt_register.question: algorithmic tenant-screen disparate-impact testing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Require vendor/landlord disparate-impact results, override rates, factor visibility, and protected-class outcome reporting.

evidence_debt_register.question: adverse-action reason specificity across tenant-screen report families
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map which specialty reports are used and whether the reason notice names the report, record, score, and correction channel.

validation_notes: rev0330 promotes this scoreboard from seed to active in the Gate 17 score-mediated-exclusion burndown; certification remains blocked unless correction, explanation, dispute, appeal, and transaction-preservation rails are shown.
